exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Health Is it important to you to eat healthy food? [Why?/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: If you catch a cold, what do you do to help you feel better? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Do you pay attention to public information about health? [Why?/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: What could you do to have a healthier lifestyle?

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe an occasion when you had to wait a long time for someone or something to arrive. You should say: who or what you were waiting for how long you had to wait why you had to wait a long time and explain how you felt about waiting a long time.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Arriving early In what kinds of situations should people always arrive early?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: How important it is to arrive early in your country?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: How can modern technology help people to arrive early?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: Being patient What kinds of jobs require the most patience?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: Is it always better to be patient in work (or studies)?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: Do you agree or disagree that the older people are, the more patient they are?
